name: Google Cloud Identity
summary: Cloud Identity is Google's identity service for organizations that do not need Workspace. The Free edition includes single sign-on to SAML apps. Premium adds automated user provisioning and context-aware access, and costs $7.20 per user per month on the flexible plan or $6 with a one-year commitment.

facts.text: Single sign-on to third-party and custom SAML apps, with Google as the identity provider, is listed for both the Free and Premium editions. The editions page does not mention OIDC.
Automated user provisioning and context-aware access are listed as Premium-only features.
Google's help page says an admin can add, modify or delete a user in the Admin console and the change syncs to the third-party app. It does not say outright that suspensions are passed on.

plans.name: Cloud Identity Free
plans.notes: SAML single sign-on, without automated provisioning or context-aware access

plans.name: Cloud Identity Premium (flexible plan)
plans.notes: No commitment, and it can be cancelled at any time without penalty

plans.name: Cloud Identity Premium (annual plan)
plans.notes: $72 per license for a one-year commitment

hiddenCosts: On the annual plan, cancelling early does not reduce what is owed, and licenses can only be reduced at renewal.

contract.cancellation: The flexible plan can be cancelled at any time without penalty. The annual plan is a one-year commitment, and early cancellation does not reduce the amount owed.
